fusions.name: Tells of Fatigue
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 5% for every tenth of its health the target still has (max 25%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Point the Way
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. When it lands, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Watch
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: Each time your stamina is full, your crit chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.
